name: Rosewood Abu Dhabi
insider_take: Where modern Arabian luxury meets timeless sophistication on Al Maryah Island's prestigious waterfront.
whats_special: This architectural marvel features the world's largest hand-knotted carpet in its lobby and offers unparalleled views of the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Located on Al Maryah Island, it's connected to the Abu Dhabi Global Market financial district and houses the city's highest rooftop pool on the 34th floor.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the rooftop restaurant for breathtaking views of the Grand Mosque's golden hour illumination – it's a sight that rivals any postcard.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Sense spa featuring traditional hammam treatments, and the nearby Galleria Al Maryah Island for world-class shopping. Take the complimentary water taxi to explore Abu Dhabi's cultural district on Saadiyat Island, home to the Louvre Abu Dhabi.
pros: Ultra-luxurious accommodations with exceptional Rosewood service standards
Prime location on Al Maryah Island with stunning waterfront views
Multiple award-winning dining venues and culinary experiences
cons: Located on island requiring transportation to mainland attractions
